order: score is the product of the four readings' shares (each the share of the 82 worlds it beats: the best 1, the worst 1/n), read as their geometric average; rank orders by score, then by the sum of the shares (as their average), then by the worst share, then by the world's id. The orders by the sum and by the worst are kept beside it, and the union of the first ten of each (bests).

readings.name: lines spread beyond luck
readings.null: the shadow world of pure luck: the same copies at the same moments and the same living, every copy's parent drawn uniformly among the living (100 replicates); the mean over the twelve eras of the z-scores of how many fewer of the clades of the era's first living still have descendants at its end, how much larger the largest clade is then, and how much more of the evolutionary activity is held by clades more active than 99% of the shadow's

readings.name: novelty above the mutation-only null
readings.null: six lines that start from the line of descent's brain at iteration 250 and make, era by era, as many changes of the world's own kind as the real line made, at random (mutations by the world's mutation_noise_std and mutation_sparsity; mixes with a contemporary drawn at random); the real line's late novelty above its own noise, less the null lines' mean (z: in the null lines' spreads)

readings.name: selection-gradient strength
readings.null: fitness (descendants at the next iteration on the brain tree) shuffled among the agents of each iteration, whose mean (0) and variance the permutation fixes exactly; the value is the median size of the standardized gradient, wealth held fixed, over four behaviours and twelve eras (a median, since the links a newborn gets are heavy-tailed); z is the root mean square of the eras' gradient z-scores

readings.name: heredity on the brain tree
readings.null: children given another pair's parent at random (200 shuffles): an index of 0 means a child acts like a stranger, 1 like its parent; z is how many spreads of the shuffled medians the real median child-parent distance lies below them
